project_name.justification: The article is titled "ArcWest Announces Option to Acquire Lemare Copper-Gold Project" and refers to the project throughout as Lemare.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the first sentence: "ArcWest Exploration Inc. (TSXV: AWX) ("ArcWest") is pleased to announce the signing of an option agreement to acquire a 100% interest in the Lemare Copper-Gold (Cu-Au) Project..."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, ArcWest, is identified in the text: "Tyler Ruks, President and CEO of ArcWest commented..."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement allows for the acquisition of a full interest: "ArcWest has signed an agreement... with respect to an option to acquire a 100% interest in the Lemare Property..."

primary_commodity.justification: The project is consistently referred to as a copper-gold project, as seen in the title: "ArcWest Announces Option to Acquire Lemare Copper-Gold Project".

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the Lemare project acquisition by ArcWest Exploration Inc., which matches the project of interest. The source URL is provided at the end of the text: "To view the source version of this press release, please visit https://www.newsfilecorp.com/release/233487"

currency.justification: The buyer, ArcWest Exploration Inc., is listed on the TSXV, a Canadian exchange, and the financial figures are denoted with a '$' symbol. This implies Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The consideration is a combined value that can be paid in cash or shares, so the `cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw` field is populated instead, as per the extraction hierarchy.

share_payments_raw.justification: The consideration is a combined value that can be paid in cash or shares, so the `cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw` field is populated instead, as per the extraction hierarchy.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The total consideration is stated as: "ArcWest can earn a 100% interest in the Property by making staged payments to the Vendor totaling $195,000 over a five year period." The text also notes that part of this can be paid in shares.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The number of shares to be issued is not specified in the agreement details.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants are mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: No stock options are mentioned as part of the transaction payment terms.

issued_share_price.justification: No specific share price for the transaction is mentioned in the agreement terms.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: A minimum expenditure is required in the first year: "In addition, ArcWest is required to fund minimum expenditures totaling at least $100,000 in the first year."

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement includes a retained royalty for the seller: "The Vendor will retain a 2% net smelter return royalty..."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The size of the project is stated multiple times: "The 3274 hectare Lemare Project..." and "Lemare is a large (3274 hectare) land package..."

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the project area is specified as hectares: "The 3274 hectare Lemare Project..."

resource_size.justification: The article describes the project as "early stage" and mentions historical sampling and limited drilling, but does not provide a quantified mineral resource estimate (e.g., tonnes, ounces) for the Lemare project itself.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first sentence of the press release: "ArcWest Exploration Inc. (TSXV: AWX) ("ArcWest") is pleased to announce..."
